# Mytholis

> Mytholis is a haute parfumerie house selling six signature Extrait de Parfum creations at 40% concentration, hand-formulated in Mayfair, London and bottled in Ahmedabad, India. The site is a direct-to-consumer storefront for collectors in India and the UK.

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://mytholis.com/): The six extraits, brand story and entry to the storefront
- [Collections](https://mytholis.com/#collections): Full catalogue of available extraits and sizes
- [Circle of Legends](https://mytholis.com/#circle-of-legends): Loyalty programme, tiers and Mythos rewards
- [Scent Quiz](https://mytholis.com/#find-scent): Short quiz that matches a visitor to an extrait
- [Heritage & Craft](https://mytholis.com/#know-us): Formulation, maceration and the house's origins

## Products

- [King Scar](https://mytholis.com/product/king-scar): Aromatic spicy extrait, 50ml and 100ml
- [Petralux](https://mytholis.com/product/petralux): Fresh floral extrait, 50ml and 100ml
- [Oud Rion](https://mytholis.com/product/oud-rion): Woody oud extrait, 50ml and 100ml
- [Spark](https://mytholis.com/product/spark): Aromatic citrus extrait, 50ml and 100ml
- [Wood Sera](https://mytholis.com/product/wood-sera): Woody aromatic extrait, 50ml and 100ml
- [Ash](https://mytholis.com/product/ash): Woody smoky extrait, 50ml and 100ml
- [Sixth Sense Discovery Set](https://mytholis.com/product/mytholis-discovery-set): Six 8ml travel flacons, one of each extrait
